weather.note: Open-Meteo forecast/ERA5 archive. Quarter-to-date is compared with the same calendar days a year earlier.

attention.note: Wikipedia (ja) daily user page views: a rough measure of public attention.

satellite.note: Mean pixel brightness (0-255) of NASA GIBS VIIRS day/night band images over a ~6 km box. Single nights are affected by cloud and moonlight, so compare medians, not days.
